topic: Korean highway rest stops (hyugeso): 200+ stops, walnut cakes, sausage-rice-cake skewer, dog parks, back gates from local roads, Haengdamdo island stop, 877K Chuseok americanos
title: In Korea, the Rest Stop Is the Destination

slides.headline: In Korea, the highway rest stop **is the destination.**
slides.note: People plan the drive around it.

slides.headline: More than **200 of them**
slides.body: Korea's expressways have over 200 rest stops, or hyugeso (휴게소). Each is a food court, café and gas station in one.

slides.headline: Walnut cakes, **served warm**
slides.body: Hodu-gwaja are small walnut-shaped cakes filled with red bean. They began in Cheonan in 1934. Now almost every stop sells them.

slides.headline: Sausage and rice cake **on one stick**
slides.body: So-tteok so-tteok stacks the two and glazes them sweet and spicy. For many Koreans, the trip starts with one.

slides.headline: Some have **a dog park**
slides.body: Deokpyeong, east of Seoul, has a grass field and a dog pool. About 20 rest stops now have dog playgrounds.

slides.headline: Some have **a back gate**
slides.body: A few stops can be reached from local roads too. People drive in for lunch without ever getting on the highway.

slides.headline: One sits **on an island**
slides.body: Haengdamdo stands on a small island under a sea bridge west of Seoul. On holiday weekends it is often the top seller.

slides.headline: Americanos sold at rest stops **over five Chuseok days**
slides.body: 2025. The top seller, ahead of walnut cakes.

slides.headline: Not a pit stop. **Part of the trip.**
slides.body: Coffee, a skewer, a box of walnut cakes for the car. For many Koreans, the stop is the best part of the drive.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.

caption:
In Korea, the highway rest stop is where the road trip actually happens.

Walnut cakes, sausage skewers, dog parks, even an island stop under a sea bridge.

What do you always buy when you stop on a long drive?
reply: One more thing: rest stop prices keep rising. Shops pay the stop about a third of their sales in fees, and the government plans to change the system next year. What is the one snack you always grab on a long drive where you live?
fact_check: 2장: 2026년 기준 직영 제외 전국 203개 휴게소 평균 수수료율 33.2%(MTN 2026-10-06) — 200곳 이상.
4장: 소떡소떡 = 소시지+떡 꼬치, 대표 휴게소 간식(2024 설 떡꼬치 24만1600개 판매 4위, 세계일보).
5장: 덕평자연휴게소 덕평펫파크(천연잔디·애견수영장) 2026-06 재오픈. 반려견 놀이터 전국 20곳(뉴시스 2025-10-02).
6장: 덕평은 국도 주차장으로도 출입 가능(동해뉴스). 개방형 휴게소 사례.
7장: 행담도휴게소 서해대교 아래 섬, 명절 매출 1위 다수 보도(덕평과 1·2위 다툼). 금액은 연도 불확실해 뺌.
8장: 2025 추석 연휴 전후 5일 아메리카노 87만7000개·41억8000만원 1위, 호두과자 52만9000개(황희 의원실, 도로공사 자료).
댓글: 평균 수수료율 33.2%, 2027년 초 공공관리회사 직계약 전환 방침(뉴시스·데일리안 2026-07-09).
